name: ffp-multiplication
source:
Print FFP($80000141)*FFP($c0000041)
Print FFP($cccccd3d)*FFP($cccccd3d)
Print FFP($80000140)*FFP($fffffe40)
Print FFP($8000007f)*FFP($80000041)
Print FFP($80000081)*FFP($80000040)

encoding.notes: Hand-specified Print=0x0476, FFP literal=0x0046 and arithmetic=0xffe2 opcodes, big-endian literal words and line lengths. Independent of the production token table/encoder. FFP(bits) in source is descriptive notation rather than an implemented AMOS function.

evidence.notes: Expectations follow the preserved Motorola FFPMUL2 routine: exact high product bits, magnitude rounding, normalization carry and exponent guards before normalization. This is the higher-accuracy multiply variant; identifying the multiply implementation in the intended Kickstart mathffp.library remains outstanding. No AMOS/emulator execution has been captured.
